request: Roadmap RM41 tier 4, ticket MAG-45. Add a stored, auto-set three-state status column to charging.supercharger_sessions: one migration (TEXT + CHECK, DEFAULT IN_PROGRESS, all existing rows backfilled to DONE_CALCULATED), a sessionStatusFor helper computing it inside VerifySession, the field on charging.Session and the read port, sqlc regeneration, integration-test additions, and four doc files.

tasks.title: Leader presents the database design to the owner and gets confirmation
tasks.notes: Owner confirmed the design as written: TEXT + CHECK three codes, DEFAULT IN_PROGRESS, all existing rows backfilled to DONE_CALCULATED, no index. Chose it over changing the state rule or adding the partial index now.

tasks.title: charging.go: SessionStatus type, constants and the Session field
session_verifier.go: sessionStatusFor + wire it into VerifySession
db/query.sql: status in the VerifySuperchargerSession SET clause + both guarding comments
Run make sqlc to regenerate the generated types
db_session_verifier_integration_test.go: the design.md Test Contract cases
[granted] root README.md: the supercharger_sessions row + the pre-existing 'five' staleness
Verify the spec delta still applies cleanly against the current main spec
Assistant-run signals: build, vet, gofmt, migration-guard, boundary-guard
Owner runs make migrate-up, the status count check, and the suite

decisions.what: Owner confirmed the tier 4 database design as written: status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IN_PROGRESS' CHECK three codes, a separate unconditional UPDATE backfilling every existing row to DONE_CALCULATED, no index.
decisions.why: Leader showed the schema, the state truth table, the index plan with its revisit trigger, the lossy Down, and the three rejected alternatives. Owner chose apply-as-designed over changing the state rule or adding the partial index now.

decisions.what: The worker's fix of the root README's pre-existing 'five battery-percentage columns' error (should be three since tiers 2-3) stays in this change as task 4.2 rather than becoming a backlog entry.
decisions.why: Tier 4 must edit that exact sentence anyway to add the status column, so correcting it costs nothing and leaving it wrong in a sentence we are rewriting would be deliberate.

events.what: Artifacts created by the charging worker (Sonnet); openspec validate --strict passes. Doc-pack acknowledged. Leader independently verified: 20260903000004 is unique across all four module migration dirs and sorts after the repo-wide newest (20260903000003); SessionMirror carries no percentage field and MirrorSuperchargerSession's INSERT/ON CONFLICT lists exclude every verification column, confirming the worker's finding that the nightly sync needs no status recompute.

Leader closed a gap D11 left open BEFORE dispatch, with two owner decisions: (a) VerifySession sets the status itself at write time, because battery_pct_source cannot distinguish a derived start from a typed one and the writer is the only place that knows; (b) every existing row backfills to DONE_CALCULATED. The leader showed the owner that recomputing the derivation matches only 3 of 10 rows, and that 4 rows have a NULL energy_kwh so could never have been derived; the owner confirmed DONE_CALCULATED for all of them on provenance the data cannot show.
DATABASE DESIGN GATE PASSED: the owner confirmed the migration, the state truth table, and the no-index plan. Task 0.1 done.

Worker flagged three things rather than papering over them: the root README's pre-existing 'five columns' staleness (folded into task 4.2), that the roadmap's 'expose it on the read port' needs no SQL change because the three reads already SELECT *, and a test-fixture session-ID block collision it caught and renumbered itself before finalizing.
